name: claudebridge
description: Connect Claude Desktop with Codex CLI for task delegation, progress tracking and project handoffs.
long_description: Project-scoped MCP bridge for Claude Desktop and Codex CLI. Supports asynchronous tasks, read-only code reviews, status, cancellation, handoff notes, and Codex session continuation. Uses your existing Codex CLI login; no API key is required.

project_directory.title: Project directory
project_directory.description: Local source-code directory for Claude and Codex collaboration. Reconfigure the extension when switching projects.

tools.name: bridge_health
tools.description: Check Codex CLI and project setup.

tools.name: bridge_delegate
tools.description: Start a project-scoped background Codex coding or review task.

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: List or inspect Codex jobs and progress.

tools.name: bridge_resume
tools.description: Continue a prior Codex session with new instructions.

tools.name: bridge_context
tools.description: Read shared handoff notes and recent activity.
